column1: # ZAP alert handling for DAST scans: <alert id> <TAB> IGNORE|WARN|FAIL <TAB> comment

column3: Strict-Transport-Security - ephemeral scan target is plain HTTP, TLS terminates at the ALB
Anti-CSRF tokens - forms are Next.js server actions, which reject cross-origin requests by Origin check
Anti-clickjacking - X-Frame-Options: DENY is set in next.config.ts (#139)
X-Content-Type-Options - nosniff is set in next.config.ts (#139)

column1: # 90004 (COOP/CORP/COEP) stays WARN: COEP is deliberately not sent, so FAIL would always trip.
# 10038 (CSP) stays WARN until a CSP is added.
